name: attack-body
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: eight-cel body-only anime heroine attack sprite sheet for a 560ms game animation.
Reference image is exact character identity, proportions, costume and drawing style: cute white/lilac side-braid heroine with teal eyes, white teal gold outfit, moon brooch, gold flower, teal hair bow and white boots. Preserve those exactly. REMOVE the weapon completely for this body sheet. Her anatomical right hand (the reference sword hand on the viewer's left at rest) is an EMPTY CLOSED GRIPPING FIST in every frame. There is NO sword, blade, handle, hilt, stick or weapon anywhere on this sheet. One fixed weapon will be attached later in the game.
Native transparent PNG background, all empty space alpha0. Do not draw a checkerboard or an opaque background. No shadows, effects, trails, glow, text, numerals or dividers.
Canvas 2048x1536. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses in FOUR columns and TWO rows, one full heroine per invisible equal cell, in row-major order. Stable scale, camera and character proportions, head-to-boots fully visible within every cell with slim margin. Pelvis horizontal anchor remains centered in each cell, grounded feet have a stable baseline. She faces right in three-quarter view. Exactly two arms and two hands, consistent anatomy. The same right fist performs the action throughout; free hand stays nearby chest or side outside the eventual blade path.
A NATURAL DIAGONAL SWORD CUT body mechanic, driven by shoulder and torso rotation, keeping the sword-side ELBOW BENT and fist close to her torso. Never punch, thrust, jab, reach the sword hand far toward the target or fully straighten that arm. Small grounded weight shift, no lunging jump. Distinct sequential motion, braid and cape lag naturally with the torso turn.
Cel 0 (top left): reference ready stance but NO sword; empty closed gripping right fist near front waist, free hand resting open nearby side.
Cel 1: knees lower slightly, right fist rises toward its shoulder, elbow bends.
Cel 2: anticipation peak, right fist lifted beside/just above her head, elbow visibly bent; torso/shoulders wind backward.
Cel 3: shoulders rotate into diagonal cut; right bent elbow and fist descend across chest, fist stays close to upper torso, NEVER extended forward.
Cel 4 (bottom left): follow-through across body, torso turns right; right fist passes close in front of upper waist, elbow remains bent.
Cel 5: fist completes low across lower torso, knees absorb movement; elbow remains bent, braid/cape swing with lag.
Cel 6: recover toward initial posture, fist returns near original waist location.
Cel 7: same original ready stance as cel 0, empty closed gripping fist near waist.
Keep first and last poses matching for a clean animation loop. Other cels must show actual coherent arm/shoulder/knee changes. No weapon art.

extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Remove the background from this eight-pose character sprite sheet and make the background transparent. Extract all EIGHT full-body heroines together, in the same four columns and two rows. Output a real transparent PNG with an alpha channel; empty background must be alpha0. Remove the gray/white checkerboard completely. Preserve the exact 1448x1086 canvas, eight positions, full body silhouettes, scale, every arm/hand/fist, facial features, opaque white hair and clothes, boots, bows and cape. Do not redraw or change any pose. No weapon art. No new background, no painted transparency checkerboard. Only remove the background; preserve every piece of the eight figures with clean antialiased edges.

visualQA.anatomy: Two arms and two hands per body; consistent empty gripping fist; bent elbow passes close across chest and waist during diagonal cut; no extended forward thrust.
notes: Small per-cel scale/baseline variations and alpha fringe specks remain in raw generated sheet.
Owner handled anchors, packing and game playback QA after delivery.

status: native-alpha final asset validated and accepted by owner

name: moon-katana
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one isolated consistent weapon sprite for the attached cute anime heroine. Use her original cyan blade, dark teal/black wrapped grip, and circular gold guard as palette/style references, but render a gently curved SINGLE-EDGED moon katana suitable for cutting.
Genuine transparent PNG background with alpha0 empty pixels. Exactly one weapon, no character, body, hand, scabbard, effects, text, shadow or checkerboard.
Canvas 1536x512, entire long weapon centered with slim margins. Horizontal side profile, handle on LEFT and blade tip on RIGHT, blade curves slightly upward toward tip. Perfect flat 2D side view and zero perspective. Dark teal/black wrapped grip with teal diamond insets, gold pommel, gold ROUND guard at blade base. A graceful solid cyan gently curved katana blade. Clearly ONE cutting edge: BRIGHT convex cutting edge is along the LOWER side of blade; DARK straight-to-concave unsharpened spine is along the UPPER side. Distinct upward-curving katana point. Do not make a symmetric double-edged straight sword. Match the reference's crisp black outlines, clean anime game illustration and teal/gold/white palette. The sword will be rotated as one fixed sprite, never mirrored. Output a clean complete isolated weapon on native transparency.

extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Remove the background from this isolated katana image and make the background transparent. Output one real transparent PNG with an alpha channel and alpha0 empty pixels. Remove all gray/white checkerboard. Preserve the ENTIRE single sword exactly: cyan gently curved blade, white cutting edge BELOW, dark spine ABOVE, handle LEFT, tip RIGHT, black/teal wrapping and circular gold guard. Preserve the original sword pixels, geometry, orientation, size, outlines and canvas. No redrawing or altering the sword. Retain opaque white blade highlights. No background or painted checkerboard. This is transparent background extraction only.

visualQA.orientation: Handle left, blade tip right, slight upward tip curve.
visualQA.cuttingEdge: Single bright convex lower edge; dark upper spine.
notes: Fine edge fringe remains in raw extraction.
Owner handled fixed-weapon rotation and compositing after delivery.

status: native-alpha final asset validated and accepted by owner
